versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support synchronization points for buffer access Type: Draft Description: AUTOSAR shall support synchronization points for buffer access Rationale: A synchronization point defines where bypass data is sampled (read) and stimulated (written). The action of sampling may trigger the Rapid Prototyping system to perform the bypass (possibly involving the communication of the sampled data to an external system for computation) ready for reading when the stimulation occurs. A synchronization point for Rapid Prototyping is termed a service point. Use Case: The RTE generator incorporates existing service points within generated code or automatically adds them to generated code. In the latter case the added service points are described in generated ARXML to permit their processing by Rapid Prototyping tools Dependencies: MC Support Data, RTE generator Supporting Material: --
